{{Quote|Number 91406; female Rattataki; name, ah, Sraja. She's part of a classified prisoner rehabilitation program not far from here.|Cavarat|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
'''Sraja''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] criminal living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until around [[3641 BBY]] when the crime lord [[Ivory]] arranged an escape for himself and his associates. Sraja was one of the few who were on his list but was unable to escape, for she was part of a classified prisoner rehabilitation program in the [[Experiment chamber 21]] of the [[High Security Section]]. After uncovering Ivory's list, the [[Voidhound]] and [[Republic Marshall]] [[Kay Cavarat]] deduced that his associates would attempt to free Sraja, and the Voidhound rushed to intercept. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] found her in a mad state, but she still managed to reveal that Ivory found a vessel to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[the Tomb]]. Their meeting was interrupted by arrival of a corrupt prison guard named [[Legat]], who relayed captain's location to [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] of [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]]. Dust shot Sraja in the head and then he and Legat attempted to kill the Voidhound.
